name: Joseph Mueller
statement:
I am drawn to working on large format walls and using the full scale of a space to create murals that are captivating, epic, and immersive. Much contemporary street art relies on flat, two-dimensional forms, loud colors, and visual clutter, often resulting in work that is glanced at and quickly forgotten. My approach moves in the opposite direction. I aim to stop people in their tracks and hold their attention through craftsmanship, composition, and emotional depth. While taste is subjective, skill is universally recognized. My work combines monumental proportions, photorealistic detail, dynamic composition, and cinematic lighting with relatable characters and scenes to create a strong emotional impact that invites viewers to return again and again, study the work more closely, and discover additional layers, subtleties, and meaning.

Symbolism plays an important role in my murals and is incorporated in a playful, layered, and intentionally ambiguous way. This openness encourages conversation and allows each viewer to form a personal interpretation rather than  a singular, specific message. I believe this balance of universal accessibility and personal interpretation is what gives great public art its staying power.
